mods.name: Village Diplomacy
mods.description:
Village Diplomacy - A living reputation and relationship system for Minecraft villages.
Every village remembers you individually: earn their trust and they open their doors, their
chests and their best prices - or become the criminal they barricade themselves against.

Features:
• Reputation per village and per player (never global)
• 12 ranks, from LEGENDARY HERO to WANTED CRIMINAL, with trade discounts or penalties
• Witness system - your crimes only count if a villager sees you (real line of sight)
• Villages react to your rank: doors, chests, beds, bells and workstations
• Villager personalities - biome-based names, 35 traits, emotions and personal trade prices
• Innkeeper and hostel - every village elects one; sleep for 1 emerald, free at high reputation
• Iron golems with their own names, temperaments and creation stories
• Mourning, reactions to deaths and villager wills
• Living day/night cycle - villagers work, eat, light their homes and go to bed
• Claim your own village anywhere (/diplomacy claim, configurable radius)
• Guard Villagers and MCA Reborn integration - guards respect your rank and hunt wanted criminals
• 250+ contextual dialogue lines, fully translated into English, Spanish and Russian
• 70+ configuration options to tune every value, threshold and module

Build your reputation by trading, helping villagers and respecting their property - or tear
it all down and live as the villain they warn their children about.

CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/village-diplomacy
Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/mod/village-diplomacy

releases.notes:
# What's New in 1.5.0 🏘️
 
Villages no longer live in isolation. They remember what you did, they negotiate with
each other, they threaten and, if it comes to it, they go to war — with or without you.
 
## 🤝 Villages talk to each other
 
- **Diplomatic states** for every village pair: PEACE · TENSION · CRISIS · ULTIMATUM · WAR · TRUCE
- **Grievances**: each village remembers what you did to it and turns it into a *casus belli*
- **War goals**: tribute, border, submission or vengeance, named in the declaration
- **The village leader decides** whether to send an ultimatum (three days) or declare war outright
- **Mobilization**: the bells of both villages ring for a day, with a villager standing at the bell
- **The war itself**: villagers caught outside are called back to the village, the strength of both
  sides is tracked on a 0–100 score and **clashes at the front** move it and announce the result
- **Truce**: peace signs a **three-day truce** that leaves residual tension behind
 
## 🧭 New commands
 
`/diplomacy declare` · `ultimatum` · `war` · `peace` · `state` · `setstate` · `settension` ·
`grievances` · `warreadiness` · `resolve` · `setlevel` · `setrelation`
 
Everything from previous versions still works: `claim`, `unclaim`, `name`, `gift`, `list`, `info`,
`reputation`, `setrep`, `diplomacy`, `relations`, `villages`, `chest`, `get`, `getrep`…
 
## ⚙️ New settings
 
- **27 new configuration options** (**71 in total**)
 
## 🌍 Languages
 
- **Full Russian translation (2,503 keys)**, on top of the complete English and Spanish ones
 
## 🟢 Loaders in this version
 
- **1.21.1** — Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt (Java 21), all with the same features
- **1.20.1** — Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt (Java 17)
 
Download **one** file for your loader and Minecraft version; do not put two in the same `mods/`
folder. Fabric and Quilt need Fabric API. Guard Villagers and MCA Reborn are optional
(Forge/NeoForge, 1.20.1 only).
 
## 🐛 Fixes
 
- The village banner texture is a real PNG again, so it no longer shows as a missing texture
 
## 💬 The mod now has its own Discord
 
I opened a server for Village Diplomacy: bug reports, suggestions, translation fixes or just
screenshots of your wars between villages. Come and say hi: [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/8bDPJ7WarQ)
 
Everything from earlier versions is still there: villager personalities, iron golem temperaments,
the last will, village names, the 12 reputation ranks and the innkeeper hostels.
 
This update is fully translated into English, Spanish and Russian.

releases.notes:
# What's New in 1.4.0 🏘️

## 💤 Innkeeper and Hostel System
- Each village now chooses an **innkeeper**, with their own name and level
- Sleep in their hostel beds for 1 emerald (gold message)
- With a reputation **≥ 100, accommodation is FREE**
- Proximity messages when entering and leaving the hostel area
- The innkeeper has unique dialogues and reacts to your reputation

## 👁️ Witness System (fairer and more realistic)
- Your crimes now only count if **a villager actually sees you** (line of sight)
- Igniting TNT: -10 · Arming TNT: -20 · Explosion: -50 · Lava: -25
- Underground or out of sight no longer punishes you (goodbye to the whole village "finding out" about everything!)
- Killing hostile mobs also requires a witness: if no one sees you, you don't gain reputation
- **Extinguishing village fires grants +3** if the villagers see you

## 🌾 Farming is now fair
- With a reputation ≥ 100, farming gives you reputation: planting +2, harvesting +1, fertilizing +1
- If the village hates you (≤ -100), farming still penalizes you
- Fixed the bug where farming would penalize you for no reason

## 🆕 New Commands
- `/diplomacy setrep <player> <amount>` — set the exact reputation of a player
- `/diplomacy gift [amount]` — gift the held item to the village (emerald +15, diamond +12, golden apple +20, ingot +8, bread/carrot/potato +6, book +8, coal +5)
- `/diplomacy list` improved — your reputations by village, sorted, with level and % discount (green) or markup (red)
- `/diplomacy info` improved — level, trade %, distance, and number of villagers

## 🎨 Updated colors in all dialogues
- New format `[Name]` with colors in ALL messages
- Alert notifications in red, rewards in green and gold
- Reputation HUD with colored tags by level
- Reputation levels now translated EN/ES

## 🤖 Compatibility with MCA Reborn
- The guards in MCA Reborn react to your reputation
- Custom welcome messages upon entering (hero → enemy)
- Reactions when attacking or killing guards, and when killing hostile mobs near them
- Compatibility via reflection: no hard dependency

## 🟠 Support for NeoForge (1.20.1)
- New jar for NeoForge 1.20.1 (47.1.x)
- Same features as Forge, Fabric, and Quilt

## ⚙️ Revamped Configuration
- All reputation values are now configurable (killing mobs, stealing, breaking blocks, beds, etc.)
- New section [reputation_decay] — reputation decay per day
- New section [notifications] — sound and title when changing levels
- New section [modules] — enable/disable personalities, mourning, golems, and inter-village relationships

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Killing mobs underground no longer grants reputation without witnesses
- TNT/lava underground without witnesses no longer penalizes
- Farming no longer unfairly lowers reputation

## ☕ Support the mod on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/cesoti)!
## 📢 Questions or suggestions? Leave a comment or message me on Discord: [Cesoti](https://discord.com/users/673081005971603486)

This update is fully translated into **English and Spanish**.

releases.notes:
What's New in 1.3.0
🏘️ Village Claiming System
 
/diplomacy claim <name> — Create your own village anywhere in the world!
/diplomacy unclaim — Release your claimed village
Configurable radius (16–128 blocks, default 48)
Player-placed block tracking for custom village areas
 
🛡️ Guard Villagers Full Integration
 
Complete Guard Villagers mod compatibility
Guards react to your village reputation upon entry with personalized messages
Guards act as witnesses — earn extra reputation when you kill hostile mobs near them
Configurable attack penalties (default -5) and kill penalties (default -100) for guards
Witness bonus for mob kills near guards (default +3)
New [guard_villagers] config section with 4 options
 
📦 Quilt Loader Support
 
Now available for Quilt (Minecraft 1.20.1)
Fabric jar is dual-compatible — works on both Fabric and Quilt loaders
Seamless integration with your preferred modded environment
 
⚙️ New Configuration Options
 
enableEntryMessages — Toggle village entry/exit banners on or off
[guard_villagers] section — attackGuard, killGuard, witnessBonus, welcomeMessage
All penalties and bonuses now properly read from config files
 
🧹 Code Optimization & Cleanup
 
Removed unused code, imports, and dead fields across the entire mod
Added null safety annotations for cleaner builds
Streamlined build scripts and removed legacy empty files
Removed NeoForge module (not available for Minecraft 1.20.1)
Updated .gitignore for professional repository structure
 
🐛 Bug Fixes
 
Custom village names now display correctly in entry/exit messages
Village detection radius no longer too large for custom claimed villages
Guard attack/kill penalties now use config values instead of hardcoded numbers
Fixed guardvillagers compatibility to use reflection (no compile-time dependency)
 
☕ Support the mod on [Ko-fi!](https://ko-fi.com/cesoti) 📢 Questions or suggestions? Leave a comment here or message me on Discord: [Cesoti](https://discord.com/users/673081005971603486)
 
This update is fully localized in English and Spanish.
